meta.name: plan
meta.description: Sequence an understood outcome into verifiable delivery slices with dependencies, ownership and acceptance checks. Use for delivery planning, estimation or migration strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把想清楚的目标拆成可验收的交付步骤,标明依赖和负责人。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把一个目标拆成能落地、能验收的交付计划。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a settled goal into verifiable delivery steps with owners and dependencies.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn a goal into an actionable, verifiable delivery plan.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把一个已理解清楚的目标拆成可验证的交付切片,为每片标出依赖、负责人和验收检查,产出排好序的交付计划。
howto.when: 当你要做交付排期、估算或迁移策略时接管;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其现有的脱敏上下文与范围,不重跑准备和提问。

say.text: 把这个目标拆成交付切片,标出依赖和负责人
say.note: 产出分片计划与验收检查

say.text: 给这次迁移做分阶段排期,列清每步的验收条件
say.note: 得到带验收条件的迁移计划

say.text: 估算这份交付计划的工作量,不确定的地方保留
say.note: 未知项会被保留而非猜测

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude sequences an understood outcome into verifiable delivery slices, marking dependencies, ownership and acceptance checks, and returns an ordered delivery plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for delivery planning, estimation or a migration strategy; if called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or discovery.

say_en.text: Turn this outcome into delivery slices with dependencies and owners
say_en.note: A sliced plan with acceptance checks

say_en.text: Plan this migration in stages, with acceptance conditions per step
Estimate this delivery plan and keep the unknowns open
